# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty years old at the time of the general election.  <sub>[v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c9 P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

For fifteen years, Marshall Elliott went unshaven and kept his hair uncut as part of a political vow, giving him an eccentric, peculiar look like a Viking of elder days. Once his political party won power, he went to a barber shop at midnight to have his beard shaved off and his hair trimmed. He was a noted dancer in his youth and danced with remarkable rhythmic grace.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is a witty, intelligent, and well-read man who enjoys telling stories and singing old Scotch ballads. He possesses a strong-willed, determined nature and a bit of a temper, though he frequently does not take things too seriously and enjoys jokes. He gets into a fury when he hears of children being ill-treated.

_Sources: [v4 c16 P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c37 P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 c26 P11](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0011)_

## History

Born a passionate Liberal Grit, Marshall Elliott swore at a public political meeting during a bitter election campaign that he would not cut his hair or shave his beard until the Grits returned to power. He kept his word for fifteen years, becoming a well-known local eccentric who frequently fished with Captain Jim. One New Year's Eve, he visited the lighthouse, sang ballads, and danced gracefully with Leslie Moore. When the Liberals finally won the election years later, he quietly walked out of the store on receiving the news at midnight and went straight to Augustus Palmer's barber shop to be shaved and trimmed. Shortly after his hair was cut, he married Cornelia Bryant, remaining happily wed to her for over thirteen years. On one occasion, he investigated rumors of child abuse over-harbour on Cornelia's behalf and was infuriated to learn how severely young Mary had been mistreated by Mrs. Wiley.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c38 P37](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0037), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 c8 P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008)_
